title: Dynamicisf not starting
symptom: After updating from 3.2 to 3.3 by uninstalling and installing, the user gets messages 'Returning to smb not enough data' and 'returning to profile sensitivity not enough data reason tdd miss'. Even after syncing to Nightscout, the issue persists.
cause: The cause is that the user did not have 7 days of TDD data available, likely because they uninstalled and reinstalled instead of updating, and the sync settings were not fully enabled to download all necessary data.
fix: Enable all sync options in NSClientV3 and perform a full sync. The user confirmed that turning everything on when syncing resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: Turning everything on when syncing did the trick
